Title: Elon Musk nie jest już najbogatszym człowiekiem na świecie. Niewiarygodne przetasowanie na szczycie

Summary: 
Bloomberg’s latest report shows that Elon Musk is no longer the world’s richest man. After 300 days at the top, his net worth fell to $385 billion, while 81‑year‑old Oracle co‑founder Larry Ellison surged overnight from $9 billion to $393 billion, a $101 billion jump. Ellison’s rise was driven by a 45 % increase in Oracle shares on 10 September, following quarterly results that exceeded analysts’ expectations and ambitious cloud‑service forecasts. The surge represented a record 41 % one‑day market‑cap gain, the largest in Oracle’s history, according to Business Insider. Musk’s wealth decline is partly attributed to a 14 % drop in Tesla shares during his involvement in Donald Trump’s campaign. Musk first became the richest in 2021, had been surpassed by Jeff Bezos and Bernard Arnault in subsequent years, and returned to the top last year. Now he must settle for second place. The article quotes the Bloomberg headline: 'Do zmiany na podium doszło w środę (10 września, przyp. red.)' and notes that Musk’s new position is ‘zaledwie’ second.

Summary: 
Elon Musk has lost the title of the world's richest person after his net worth fell to $385 billion, according to Bloomberg.
